The position combines service desk responsibilities with field-based support and requires regular travel between casino properties, participation in an on-call rotation, and flexibility to work varied shifts. Responsibilities Respond to IT service requests, incidents, and inquiries through phone, email, and ticketing systems. Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network connectivity, workstation, and peripheral issues. Provide on-site installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of approved technology and equipment. Assist users with password resets, account access, applications, and other routine technical needs. Escalate complex issues to appropriate support teams in accordance with established procedures. Maintain accurate service records, resolution documentation, field service activity, and IT inventory. Develop and update knowledge base documentation to support team efficiency and continuous improvement. Monitor system performance and perform routine patches, updates, and maintenance as directed. Escort vendors within facilities as needed while ensuring compliance with security requirements. Deliver a high level of customer service through clear communication, expectation management, and timely issue resolution.
